subject: Reference availability and proposed batch windows for BrightBridge
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightbridge.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for customer references - procurement timeline

Hi Logan,

We're running BrightBridge's procurement review for our new AI stack and the vendor committee has asked for two live customer reference calls and one written testimonial by next Wednesday (Dec 2). Can you provide three customers who can do 30-minute calls between Dec 1–3 (PST preferred)?

Couple constraints on our side: the committee tries to avoid talking to the same customer more than once in a 60-day window if possible. If you anticipate conflicts, we can accept a short recorded Q&A but prefer live calls.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so I can get this on the committee calendar.

—Daniel
Director of Platform Partnerships
BrightBridge Analytics
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for customer references - procurement timeline

Hi Daniel,

Thanks — we can help but want to be mindful of customer fatigue. Quick summary of what we can do this week:

- Option A (preferred): two live calls + one written blurb drawn from a short 10-min intake. We can propose a 2-hour batch window per day where customer availability is concentrated (e.g., 10–12 PST). That reduces churn on customers and keeps calls compact.
- Option B (fallback): one live call + one recorded Q&A + a written testimonial.

To move fast, I've attached our short Reference Request Form (BrightBridge-Reference-Form.pdf). If you can confirm the exact committee time ranges, we will:
  1) Check our reference pool for cooldowns/overlap,
  2) Offer 4 candidate names (so you can pick), and
  3) Propose two 90-minute batch windows for the days you prefer.

If live-only is mandatory, note that two of our most often-referenced customers finished a live call three weeks ago; we'd prefer to avoid them again inside 45 days unless they explicitly opt in. If you need more volume, we can nominate substitute contacts who have done written testimonials but not live calls.

I'll coordinate with Marissa and Neha here to confirm availability and share candidate bios.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightbridge.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for customer references - procurement timeline

Logan — thanks. Live-only is preferred by the procurement committee. They have three 30-minute slots on Dec 2: 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30, 15:30–16:00 PST. If you can nominate three customers who can do those exact times, we'll lock them. We understand cooldowns; please surface alternatives if any of those are within the 45-day window.

Daniel
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: BrightBridge reference request — cooldowns and nominees

Team — cc'ing for quick triage. Procurement wants three live 30-min calls on Thu Dec 2 at 10:00, 13:00, 15:30 PST. BrightBridge asked explicitly for live-only.

Inventory notes (quick):
- AcuMed (primary contact: Priya N.) — last live call: 2026-11-08 -> 24 days ago (inside 45-day soft cooldown).
- NovaRetail — last live call: 2026-09-15 -> 77 days ago (OK).
- Helix Labs — last live call: 2026-10-20 -> 43 days ago (borderline).
- GreenGrid — provided written testimonial only (no live calls).

My working plan: nominate NovaRetail and Helix Labs for two slots, and offer GreenGrid as the third if AcuMed doesn't want another live call. If procurement pushes back on Helix (43 days), we can instead push for GreenGrid live (we'd need to ask them ASAP to convert a written blurb to a call).

Next steps for you:
- Marissa: reach out to NovaRetail and Helix leads to confirm availability for the exact times (consider the 15:30 PST slot might be late for EMEA contacts).
- Neha: draft short candidate bios (2–3 bullets) and one-sheeter that we can send to BrightBridge.
- Ben: prepare a single-slide alternative: recorded Q&A + written blurb if procurement insists on strictly fresh live-only participants.

I'll update Daniel once we have confirmations. Ping me if anyone needs me to take the outreach.

Thanks — Logan
